data.name: Chughtoon
data.long_meaning: One who is born during the full moon night or during the 15th night of the Islamic lunar month of Sha'ban. It is also used to describe someone who is beautiful and full of grace.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and protection. Chughtoon signifies the arrival of blessings and a sense of peace and tranquility.
data.numerology_meaning: A harmonious and compassionate individual, Chughtoon is driven by a strong desire for love and beauty. She is a natural healer and has a calming effect on those around her.

in_arabic.name: چوختون
in_arabic.long_meaning: الچوختون هو اسم علم من أصل عربي، يعود إلى الفعل ch-t-q-n-، وتعني «الذى يرعى البقر» أو «الراعي».

in_urdu.name: چوختون
in_urdu.meaning: چوختون کا مطلب ہے، چھوٹے جانوروں کا رکھوالا
in_urdu.long_meaning: چوختون نام کا تعلق اردو زبان کے ساتھ ہے لیکن اس کا اصل ماخذ عرب زبان سے ہے۔ اس نام کا پہلا حصہ چوخت سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چھوٹے جانوروں کا رکھوالا۔

in_hindi.name: चुग्थून
in_hindi.meaning: चुग्थून का अर्थ है छोटे जानवरों का राखा
in_hindi.long_meaning: चुग्थून नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है छोटे जानवरों को पालने वाला।

in_pashto.name: چوختون
in_pashto.long_meaning: چوختون نومګی دوه ځلاکونو لوریوونکی، دوه چاروونکی، او دوه داسونکی دی چی پښتنو کښه د خپل جادگړي او د خپل ټپونو پورته د مزارنو په نوم پېژندل کېږي.

in_english.name: Chughtoon
in_english.meaning: Chughtoon is a name meaning small animal herder or shepherd
in_english.long_meaning: The name Chughtoon originates from the Arabic root ch-t-q-n-, meaning small animal herder or shepherd. It is a name commonly used in the Islamic tradition, symbolizing a strong connection with nature and a sense of responsibility towards animals.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Chughtoon" has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic community. It is believed that individuals born during the nights mentioned hold special significance and blessings. In many Muslim societies, such babies are lavished with love and gifts as they are believed to bring good luck and prosperity. Moreover, the name is also associated with the beauty and grace embodied in Prophet Muhammad's daughter, Fatima Al-Zahra (AS), and therefore holds an esteemed place in Muslim names and identities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Chughtoon" represents the spiritual potential and blessings associated with the night of birth. It is a reminder of the divine grace and mercy bestowed upon us, as we all begin our journey on the path to manifesting our highest potential and purpose in life. In the Islamic tradition, the night of birth is seen as a moment of great faith and blessing, and the name "Chughtoon" serves as a reminder of this sacred connection. It encourages individuals to strive for personal growth and to remember the divine guidance and blessings that accompany them on their journey.
